patthana21.4:1.1: Nahetuṃ nasahetukaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nahetu sahetuko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.4:2.1: Nahetuṃ nasahetukaṃ naakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nahetu sahetuko akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.4:3.1: Nahetuṃ naahetukaṃ naabyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu ahetuko abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
